title: OpenCode Observability Event
description: Contract between opencode-log-plugin and opencode-log-viewer. schema_version is bumped on any breaking change; this file must stay identical (synced by hand) in both repositories.

event_id.description: Unique id, used for idempotent ingestion. Format: evt_<ulid>.

source_id.description: sha256(hostname + source_name)[:16], stable per agent host+project.

session_id.description: Null for events that are not scoped to a session (e.g. lsp.updated, installation.updated, pty.*, vcs.branch.updated).

sequence.description: Monotonic counter within the plugin process, used to restore order when timestamps tie.

event_type.description: OpenCode Bus event type (e.g. message.part.updated) or a plugin-internal diagnostic type prefixed with plugin. (e.g. plugin.events_dropped).

event_time.description: Timestamp reported by OpenCode itself, if the event payload carries one. Null if OpenCode did not provide one.

observed_at.description: Moment the plugin process received the event.

payload.description: Raw event payload as received from OpenCode (Bus Event.properties, or the tool.execute.before/after hook input+output), unmodified except for truncation.

truncated.description: True if payload was cut down to fit OPENCODE_LOG_MAX_PAYLOAD.

original_size.description: Original payload size in bytes, present when truncated=true.
